answer: Use distrust propagation anchored to a public beacon: when an identity is proven fake, a penalty ripples along its endorsement graph, discounting the standing of every identity within two hops, like rot spreading through timber. Endorsers who vouched for the fake lose standing too, so a farm's own endorsements poison its cluster. Each beacon epoch, identities must also renew a lotus credential, a fresh cheap proof of recent honest work, or their standing withers. A Sybil operator thus pays twice: once to build each fake, and again as every exposure degrades the whole farm.
